messages:
elaine: Hey team — quick Q. A docs PR is blocked on the `docs-preview` check which keeps getting queued for >10min. CODEOWNERS approval is done, but GH won't auto-merge until the preview passes. Is there a documented way for docs folks to safely bypass or requeue the preview?

mike: GitHub branch protection requires that check to pass, so you can't auto-merge without it. We could either: 1) make the check optional for docs-only paths, or 2) add an approved way to retrigger.

dev-bot: docs-preview workflow started for PR #4123 (runner: linux-xlarge) — queued on hosted runners (ETA ~6m).

sara: Re: (1) — making it optional worries me because previews catch link regressions. (2) seems safer: add a small manual retrigger step for maintainers or authors.

riyaz: Agree w/ @sara. For blocked runs we usually do `/workflow run docs-preview` from the PR comments (if GH Actions configured). But our current action doesn't expose that.

docs-eng: We can add an API endpoint to the docs CI that exposes a comment trigger like `/rerun docs-preview`. Minimal change: add a repository_dispatch hook handled by the GH Action.

elaine: That would be great. Any chance we can do a lighter-weight interim fix? People keep ramping on docs and 10-15m delays are killing flow.

mike: Short term: maintainers can manually re-run the job from the Actions UI. Also if the job is stuck queued on hosted runners, increasing concurrency or switching to self-hosted for that workflow helps.

jen: +1 on self-hosted for docs-preview. We have 1 spare small runner in the docs pool — I can add it to the workflow. Should reduce queue time a lot.

dev-bot: docs-preview workflow completed for PR #4123 — success (duration 32s).

elaine: Nice — thanks @jen. For the longer-term plan, can we: 1) add `/rerun docs-preview` comment trigger, 2) add a lightweight `docs-preview-fast` job that only runs link checks + schema validation for rapid feedback, and keep full preview optional?

riyaz: Sounds reasonable. For (2) maybe call it `docs-lint-quick` and make it the required check for auto-merge, while the full `docs-preview` remains recommended. That avoids removing protections but speeds merges.

mike: Implementation notes: sample repo_dispatch trigger yaml snippet:```yml
on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [rerun-docs-preview]
```
Then a small GH App or tiny action that listens for `/rerun docs-preview` and fires repo_dispatch.

docs-eng: I'll draft a PR with the repo_dispatch + quick-lint job. Will also ping infra about adding the runner to reduce flakiness.

elaine: Perfect. If anyone wants to help review the PR, ping me and I can add reviewers. Also let's document the temporary manual rerun steps in the docs/CONTRIBUTING.md so new folks know what to do. :+1:

sara: Thanks — I'll add a short section to CONTRIBUTING.md and include the `/rerun` syntax once the action exists.

jen: Follow-up: do we want CODEOWNERS to auto-approve docs-only changes? We have `docs/**` owned by @docs-team. If we add the quick-lint required, we could allow auto-merge once codeowners approve and quick-lint passes.

mike: Preserving review is important; auto-approve has been contentious. Let's keep explicit approvals but allow auto-merge on `docs-lint-quick` + CODEOWNERS approval. I'll draft the branch-protection wording.

elaine: Great — thanks all. I'll wait for the PR and the CONTRIBUTING update.
